value.description: Through sacred rite and ancient liturgy, your tech-adepts have unlocked the knowledge to fabricate Relic Components — fragments of a bygone age when the Imperium's technological mastery was without equal. These are not merely manufactured; they are consecrated. Each component is assembled through a series of devotional rituals passed down through the Adeptus Mechanicus, invoking the blessing of the Omnissiah upon each part. To produce such components without proper sanctification would be not merely wasteful, but heretical.
